listings.caption: This code defines a LayerNorm module whose forward pass normalizes each input row using its mean and variance and then applies learnable scale and shift parameters.
listings.reason: The section describes layer normalization computed per row/batch item by taking mean and variance across the last dimension (dim=-1, keepdim=True), subtracting the mean, and dividing by the square root of the variance (with an epsilon). The code’s forward pass does exactly this and additionally applies learnable scale and shift parameters, which is consistent with a standard LayerNorm module and accurately reflected by the caption.
